edits.new: Screen Specifications v1 gives SCR-34 and SCR-35 no empty, error or no access state, so those three states are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-11823, CG-ALL-11824)

edits.old: And the case state and the work assignment are read on the rwb-case contract and never written
edits.new:
And the case state and the work assignment are read on the rwb-case contract and never written

  Scenario: AC8 The rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 hold on every build (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the build of rwb-partner for this story
    When the rule checks of section 8 run on the fakes and the boundary test
    Then each of BR1 to BR10 is asserted and none is breached

  Scenario: AC9 A provided operation answers 401, 403 or 404 when the check fails (new, D-RCV-60)
    When a caller without a credential calls a provided operation of section 12.1
    Then the answer is 401 and nothing is read
    When a caller holding Partner portal R and not C calls a provided operation
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is read
    When a provided operation is called for a resource that does not exist
    Then the answer is 404 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC10 A retried or timed-out activity writes once and holds one clock (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the placement of case "RW-2027-000831" is started
    When an activity of InstructionWorkflow times out and is retried
    Then one partner_instruction row exists, rwb.partner.InstructionIssued.v1 is published once and one partner clock is held
    And the retry adds no row, no event and no second clock

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call that fails or does not answer places nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock fails or does not answer for the measured return
    When the placement is started on case "RW-2027-000831"
    Then nothing is placed, no instruction is created and no event is published
    And the error state of section 15 is rendered

  Scenario: AC12 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns case "RW-2027-000831" at "PLACED_WITH_AGENCY"
    When the placement is started on case "RW-2027-000831"
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and no instruction is created
    And the case is read back unchanged at "PLACED_WITH_AGENCY"
